resources.string: Yvora uses this service to perform touch and scroll gestures system-wide using hand detection.
Dual hand cursors (restart engine to apply)
Assisted gestures (local fuzzy intent; restart engine)
Assist tolerance: choose feedback based on your swipes. Restart engine to apply.
Select normal, zoom, rotation or custom trajectory mode

Transform modes require dual hands. Open both palms, pinch both hands, then change separation for zoom or turn the line between the hands for rotation. Normal taps, drags and swipes are disabled in these modes. Uses screen center; supported apps only.
Live results per second and latest processed frame age. Updates only while tracking.
Adjust the active camera area to match your comfortable hand movement. Smaller area means less movement to reach screen edges.
Link X/Y settings for both hands
Cyan: left hand • Amber: right hand. Each range reaches the entire screen. Unlink to edit separately.
Diagram of active camera area and detected hand position
Start engine to test your camera.
Automatic calibration uses only the selected open hand. Review the measured range before applying. Turn off Safe calibration to resume gestures.
Optional: may help detect smaller hands further away, but can reduce speed. Does not change the physical lens field of view.
Verify the service responds before leaving the app.
Open your hand to move the cursor.
Relax the other fingers. Briefly pinch index and thumb, then release to tap. Hold until the pointer turns green, move, then open fingers to drop (Android 8+).
Right hand: index and middle fingers.
Either hand: extend fingers together, turn the edge of the palm toward the camera, then move left.
Either hand: turn the palm edge toward the camera, move right. Face the palm toward the camera to rearm.
Enable both permissions, start the engine, then hold one hand about 50–80 cm from the camera. Keep the room well lit. Use Stop in the notification to end tracking.
Faster tracking while cool, with automatic thermal fallback. May use more battery. Turn off for balanced pacing.
Draw both cursors in one fixed overlay instead of moving windows. Turn off if another app blocks touches.
